themis.rule.rankingEnabled.name: Ranking enabled
themis.rule.rankingEnabled.desc: Master switch for all Themis Lib data collection. When disabled no metric is collected at all.
themis.rule.rankingTrackPlayTime.name: Track play time
themis.rule.rankingTrackPlayTime.desc: Collect how long each player (or fake player) has been online.
themis.rule.rankingTrackBlocksMined.name: Track blocks mined
themis.rule.rankingTrackBlocksMined.desc: Collect how many blocks each player has broken.
themis.rule.rankingTrackBlocksPlaced.des: Collect how many blocks each player has placed.
themis.rule.rankingTrackMobKills.name: Track mob kills
themis.rule.rankingTrackMobKills.desc: Collect how many mobs each player has killed.
themis.rule.rankingTrackPlayerKills.name: Track player kills
themis.rule.rankingTrackPlayerKills.desc: Collect how many players each player has killed.
themis.rule.rankingTrackDeaths.name: Track deaths
themis.rule.rankingTrackDeaths.desc: Collect how many times each player has died.
themis.rule.rankingTrackVillagerTrades.d: Collect how many villager trades each player has made.
themis.rule.rankingTrackFishCaught.name: Track fish caught
themis.rule.rankingTrackFishCaught.desc: Collect how many times each player has reeled in a fishing hook.
themis.rule.rankingTrackElytraDistance.d: Collect the distance flown with an elytra, in centi-blocks.
themis.rule.rankingTrackDamageDealt.name: Track damage dealt
themis.rule.rankingTrackDamageDealt.desc: Collect the amount of damage each player has dealt.
themis.rule.rankingTrackDamageTaken.name: Track damage taken
themis.rule.rankingTrackDamageTaken.desc: Collect the amount of damage each player has taken.
themis.rule.rankingTrackMovement.name: Track movement
themis.rule.rankingTrackMovement.desc: Collect walking, sprinting, swimming, riding and elytra distance, in centi-blocks.
themis.rule.rankingTrackItemsCrafted.des: Collect the number of items produced by crafting.
themis.rule.rankingTrackItemsPickedUp.de: Collect the number of items picked up from the ground.
themis.rule.rankingTrackItemsDropped.des: Collect the number of items dropped on the ground.
themis.rule.rankingTrackItemsUsed.name: Track items used
themis.rule.rankingTrackItemsUsed.desc: Collect how many times each player has used an item.
themis.rule.rankingTrackItemsBroken.name: Track items damaged and broken
themis.rule.rankingTrackItemsBroken.desc: Collect durability damage events and tools or armour that broke completely.
themis.rule.rankingTrackAnimalsBred.name: Track animals bred
themis.rule.rankingTrackAnimalsBred.desc: Collect how many times each player has bred animals.
themis.rule.rankingTrackAnimalsTamed.des: Collect how many animals each player has tamed.
themis.rule.rankingTrackEnchantments.des: Collect how many enchantments each player has applied.
themis.rule.rankingTrackJumps.name: Track jumps
themis.rule.rankingTrackJumps.desc: Collect how many times each player has jumped.
themis.rule.rankingMinedNaturalOnly.name: Only count natural blocks as mined
themis.rule.rankingMinedNaturalOnly.desc: Only count blocks that were not placed by a player. Prevents place-then-mine farming.
themis.rule.rankingSeparateFakePlayers.d: Store fake player data in the FAKE domain instead of REAL. When disabled fake data still keeps its own UUID, so real player data is never overwritten.
